Theorem
[global curvature derivative estimates] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 1.4.1\group Cao–Zhu Derivative Estimates There are constants $C_m$, depending only on $m$ and the dimension, such that a complete Ricci flow satisfying $|\Rm |\le M$ up to $0<t\le M^{-1}$ satisfies \[ | abla \Rm |\le C_1M t^{-1/2},\qquad | abla ^m\Rm |\le C_mM t^{-m/2}. \] All norms are taken in the evolving metric \cite{Sh89}.
Proof

↗ prop:cz-evolution-of-the-riemann-curvature-tensor \sketch The equations $\partial _t\Rm =\Delta \Rm +\Rm *\Rm $ and its covariant derivatives give differential inequalities for $| abla ^m\Rm |^2$. Apply the maximum principle first to $t| abla \Rm |^2+A|\Rm |^2$, then inductively to weighted sums of successive derivative norms.

□
